overall: Strong final draft: 183/183 pool tokens covered (178 multi, 5 exclusive), 654 items, checker ok_rate 1.0. Facts are accurate and almost all items stay clear of Halloween customs (pumpkin, candy, costume, trick, treat, Oct and the like are tested through Thanksgiving, Cinderella, Christmas, ballet, bridge, hat-tricks, other October dates and so on). The main residual risk is horror-genre knowledge: four items hinge on horror films or horror icons (Psycho, Ringu, The Shining's setting, Pennywise) and are dropped, while classic literature items (Dracula, Frankenstein, Poe, Lovecraft, Stephen King as author) are kept as general knowledge. One item has two defensible answers (Salome also finds the empty tomb in Mark) and is dropped. Class calls are reasonable; several thin tokens have fewer than 4 items with honest notes. Totals: 649 keep, 5 drop.
